items.title: UK YouTuber Yung Filly found not guilty of raping Perth woman after concert

children.content: Yung Filly, real name Andres Barrientos, is acquitted of raping a young fan in a Perth hotel room in 2024, but a jury finds him guilty of assault causing bodily harm and is unable to agree on three further counts of rape.

items.title: Deputy premier denies being influenced by Perth property developer

children.content: WA's Deputy Premier Rita Saffioti says allegations made over her conduct as a minister arising from a secret recording at the heart of a defamation trial are "extreme".

items.title: Gina Rinehart puts ABC on notice over Race Around the World episode

children.content: An analysis of cargo from one of Western Australia's best-known shipwrecks reveals "the building blocks of an empire", centuries after the Batavia's disastrous voyage in 1629 and the deadly mutiny that followed.

items.title: Fresh strike planned against BHP in WA's north, this time lasting 24 hours

children.content: BHP is facing renewed industrial action at its Port Hedland operations in Western Australia, with unions planning a 24-hour strike against the mining giant on August 9.

image.altText: Various shots from the eight hour strike staged by unionised BHP staff in Port Hedland on Thursday 16/7/2026.

children.content: There are only 30 critically endangered Queen of Sheba orchids left on earth, but scientists at Kings Park have made a breakthrough using a cloning technique that could save the species.

articles.title: It's easy to see why Australia brought a psychiatrist to Glasgow

children.content: With just moments to execute on years of training, planning and expectation, tension is high for athletes at the Commonwealth Games. For the first time, Team Australia has a psychiatrist along for the ride.

articles.title: How a classification change ended Korey's Commonwealth Games hopes

children.content: Korey Boddington was briefly in the frame to compete at the 2026 Commonwealth Games but was classified out of the competition. It's not an uncommon situation, as athletes battle with "difficult" conversations around para sport.
